'''Vyrhawk fighter-bombers''' were a class of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] around [[44 ABY]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] deployed the fighter-[[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] class [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] during their [[siege of the New Jedi Temple]].
